scenarios.title: Registration page renders readable typography and contained controls on desktop viewports
given: A user navigates to the Registration page on a desktop-sized display
then: Typography for headings, labels, and text remains legible with appropriate line height and proportions
Form controls, inputs, and interactive buttons are contained within their defined boundaries without overflowing the layout container

scenarios.title: Registration page scales typography and contains controls responsively on mobile viewports
given: A user navigates to the Registration page on a mobile device or narrow viewport
then: Typography scales responsively so that all text remains readable without clipping
Form controls, input fields, and action buttons fit within the viewport width without causing unintended horizontal page scrolling

scenarios.title: Clear notification is shown when browser lacks QR webcam support while manual ID entry remains accessible
given: A user visits the Registration page using a browser or environment that lacks QR webcam support
then: A clear message is displayed informing the user that their browser lacks QR webcam scanning support
The manual ID entry input field and submission control remain visible and interactive

scenarios.title: Webcam scanner is presented when supported alongside manual ID entry
given: A user visits the Registration page using a browser that supports QR webcam scanning
then: The QR webcam scanner interface is available to the user
The manual ID entry option remains accessible alongside the webcam scanner

scenarios.title: User can successfully complete registration via manual ID entry when webcam is unsupported
given: A user is on the Registration page in a browser without QR webcam support
The browser displays the unsupported webcam notification
scenarios.when: The user enters a registration identifier (e.g. REG12345) into the manual ID entry field and submits
then: The manual identifier submission is processed
The user observes the outcome or confirmation of their registration entry
